sectionHints.host: Advisory checks for the Node.js and npm used by ACP Agents (path and version).
sectionHints.agents: Re-probes each registered Agent via ACP initialize (no prompt is sent). Slow Agents can take up to 30s.
sectionHints.network: Probes the paper sources and common hosts through the configured proxy.
sectionHints.vault: Checks top-level papers/, notes/, and .agentero/ folders.
sectionHints.catalog: Checks that .agentero/catalog.sqlite exists and its schema matches this app.
sectionHints.wikilinks: Checks local wiki links for missing, ambiguous, or invalid heading targets.
sectionHints.aliases: Checks paper NOTES.md for at least two distinct frontmatter aliases.
sectionHints.visualMarks: Migrates legacy agent-trace marks to nested visual v2 (note-only marks stay valid).
